344 A Beautiful Woman Should Wear Beautiful Clothes; Crying! (1)

Today, when geologists discovered that there was a gold mine in the southern suburbs, it caused quite a stir in Jiangbei City.

Many people, including the Jiangbei government, wanted to get involved.

However, they soon discovered that the mountains had an owner.

The master’s name was Lin Fan.

That was why Liu Yuhang had called Lin Fan.

Liu Yuhang and Lin Fan chatted for a while more before hanging up.

Lin Fan rubbed his chin and said, “A gold mine?”

After thinking for a moment, he dialed the number of the general manager of the Flying Dragon Security Company, Wang Shengli.

Wang Shengli seemed to have been waiting for the call. It rang once before it was immediately picked up.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. What can I do for you?” Wang Shengli said in an extremely respectful tone.

Lin Fan was quite satisfied with Wang Shengli.

The preparation of buses every time he and his coursemates gathered as well as how he handled the situation at the Hyatt Hotel previously showed that he had good work ability and attitude.

Lin Fan said, “I found a gold mine in the mountains in the southern suburbs. Do you have a way to mine it?”

When Wang Shengli heard this, his breathing became hurried.

Was Mr. Lin going to put him in an important position?

“Mr. Lin, I promise that I can extract all the gold!” he said excitedly.

“Good!” Lin Fan said.

After Lin Fan finished his breakfast, he drove his Mercedes-Benz G-Class and headed straight for the KM mall.

He had made an appointment with Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling to go shopping together yesterday.

During this period of time, he was either in school, accompanying Ling Rou, or going to Li City to fetch Su Ningjing.

As a result, it had been a while since he had accompanied Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling.

…

At this moment, Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling had already arrived at the entrance of the KM Mall.

Qiu Ziqian was wearing a colorful dress today. It complemented her voluptuous figure and snow-white skin. She looked like a fairy standing in the rainbow.

Huang Ling was wearing a light yellow dress. Her beautiful face and perfect figure were filled with warmth. She could melt people’s hearts.

The two of them stood at the entrance like beautiful scenery, attracting the gazes of all the handsome men and beautiful women who came in and out.

At the same time, they also attracted the attention of a man with long back hair who was dressed in a white shirt. His name was Guo Zixiang.

Guo Zixiang was an ordinary white-collar worker.

Usually, his hair would be styled in a bowl cut and he would wear gold-rimmed glasses every day. He was a yes-man in the company.

Today…

He changed his style and did a hairstyle that he thought was handsome. He changed into fashionable black-rimmed glasses, raised his head, puffed out his chest, and walked forward with arrogance. He was very smug.

Last night, his father called to say that there was a mine in the mountain in front of their house—a gold mine!

After Guo Zixiang received the news, he immediately jumped up for joy.

A gold mine!

This meant… he would soon become a super-rich tycoon!

In the past, he had been submissive because he always felt that he was poor and inferior.

Now that he knew he was going to be rich, he was completely free.

The sleeping beast in his heart had finally awakened.

In the past, Guo Zixiang would never dare to strike up a conversation with a beautiful woman.

Today, however, he dared to!

…

Qiu Ziqian said, “Lin Fan should be here in a while. Let’s go to the entrance and take a walk.”

“Yes, yes!” Huang Ling said.

Hence, the two of them walked into the Chanel shop at the entrance.

“Welcome to Chanel.” The saleswoman smiled and said, “May I help you?”

“We’ll just take a look first,” Qiu Ziqian said.

“Alright,” the female sales assistant said.

Hence, Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling looked at the clothes one by one and compared them to the other. They were like children who had seen their favorite toy and their faces were full of smiles.

However, they did not notice that a man had been following behind them. It was Guo Zixiang.

It was Guo Zixiang’s first time entering a Chanel store.

He first stole a glance at Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling. Then, he could not help but pick up two pieces of clothing to secretly look at the price.

28,999 yuan!

45,888 yuan!

Guo Zixiang was shocked and could not help but take two steps back.

The price was simply too expensive.

At this moment, Huang Ling suddenly noticed the blue garment of clothing that Guo Zixiang had just seen. The price was 28,999 yuan. She said, “That one seems pretty good.”

When Guo Zixiang heard this voice, his entire person went a little limp.

Then, he suddenly thought of something.

He was now a super-rich tycoon!

It was just a dress that cost tens of thousands of yuan!

Thus, he raised his head again like a gentleman and took two steps forward. He picked up the piece of clothing that cost 28,999 yuan and smiled at Huang Ling. “Beautiful women should wear more expensive clothes.”

Then, he turned to the salesperson and said, “Hello, please wrap this dress up.”

After saying that, he handed over a bank card.

“Alright,” the salesperson said.

She picked up the bank card and swiped it gently on the POS machine.

Beep!

A crisp sound rang out from the machine.

Then, the receipt appeared.

Guo Zixiang picked up the dress and handed it to Huang Ling, saying, “For you, pretty lady.”

He felt that he was so cool now.

The beauty would definitely be touched beyond words.

Guo Zixiang even began to imagine… he and Huang Ling eating together and holding hands.
